senses.gloss: , <he>אח״ס בט״ע</he>, a formula representing a permutation of letters wherein the first (<cite ref="A00000"><he>א</he></cite>) interchanges with the eighth (<cite ref="H00000"><he>ח</he></cite>) and with the fifteenth (<cite ref="O00000"><he>ס</he></cite>); the second (<cite ref="B00000"><he>ב</he></cite>) with the ninth (<cite ref="I00000"><he>ט</he></cite>) and with the sixteenth (<cite ref="P00000"><he>ע</he></cite>), &c.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 104a:12">Sabb. 104ᵃ</cite> <he>אח״ס בט״ע גי״ף</he> = <he>א̇ני ח̇ס̇ עליהם מפני שב̇ע̇ט̇ו בג̇י̇ף̇</he> I shall spare them because they resisted sensual temptations; v. <cite ref="C00789"><he>גִּיף</he></cite>
